reviews.title: Do you need a new case but hate modern cases?
reviews.comment:
If want a subdued looking build without RGB this is a great case.
Plenty of room while not being too big. Easy to build in. No easily broken glass side panel. It even has two 5.25" drive bays in the bottom, if you have an optical drive or want add more front I/O ports at some point.
reviews.author: NotAShill
